note: PROD-008: Express handlers under a crmProxies prefix. The proxy is registered first, so these never run in dev; production never reaches Express at all. Each is either dead code to delete or behaviour to port into the edge function and then delete. This list only shrinks — the one exception was PROD-008b teaching the scanner to see prefix-mounted routers, which added 131 handlers it had never been able to match. That was a measurement correction, not a regression.
